messages:
maya: FYI saw a noisy eu->na flap this morning. probes were ~40s stale, routers oscillated. Proposing combined fixes: tokenized probe bursts + decision hysteresis + a console kill-switch.
sam: agree on combined approach. token buckets avoid global probe storms. hysteresis reduces flip-flop. need fast path for gold tenants.
emily: blob idea: compiler emits tiny signed blobs with allowed_regions, soft_penalties, gravity, ttl_ms, version. routers merge blob with live signals. keep blob <=200 bytes.
raj: token service sketch: per-tenant bucket with capacity B and refill R. routers request tokens when variance detected; control plane grants small bursts with cooldown. include jitter.
nate: ops needs metrics: token_consumption, token_starvation, hysteresis_deferrals, forced_failovers, blob_version_spread. add alert when token_starvation spikes.
liam: plan for tiers: gold=1 window, default=2, sandbox=3. windows 3-5s. critical_delta_override bypasses hysteresis if latency delta > threshold.
maya: also add region kill-switch in console so SRE can force local-only routing during partitions. default conservative.
sam: I'll prototype runtime hysteresis+sim harness to replay the spike. emily, can you spec the blob proto so sim can consume it?
emily: will draft spec and serializer today. include signature field and ttl.
raj: will prototype token service next sprint. will include backoff and per-tenant limits.
nate: will add dashboards and a console toggle for per-tenant knobs. alerting rule for deferred_switch_count > 5% sustained.
ops-bot: incident note: 1770019600 - eu1 probe jitter; auto-fallback to na for tenant 'alpha' at 1770019625; duration 8m; estimated tail impact +0.6%.
maya: next steps: 1) canary runtime hysteresis in staging; 2) token service prototype; 3) compiler blob PR; 4) telemetry + console flags. keep defaults conservative and allow per-tenant opt-in. thanks all. :rocket:
